title: Event envelope v1
description: The shape every event on the mycelium carries. Payload shape is the per-type contract in events/.

causation_id.description: audit_log.id whose insert produced this event; null only for ops events with no ledger row

trace_id.description: the AXIS run an officer produced this event from; null for ledger-derived events, which have no run behind them

correlation_id.description: groups the events of one causal chain (canonical Conclave field); null when the event starts a chain of its own
